title: Collection coverage thresholds (RFO v19.2.0)
summary: Single source of truth for the minimum_independent_sources threshold consumed by both the strict-profile coverage validator and the runtime collector cap (RFO_MAX_EXTERNAL_SOURCES default).
rationale: Phase 4C P0-1 closure: previous default RFO_MAX_EXTERNAL_SOURCES=8 made strict coverage unreachable even with a working backend. Cap now defaults to the contract minimum so strict coverage is operator-attainable out of the box.
